indexventures.com.name: Index Ventures
indexventures.com.note: The defining London franchise; feeds Highland at A/B and competes at growth. Every serious UK process touches them.

accel.com.name: Accel
accel.com.note: US fund, London office; Europe's best Series A portfolio for 20 years - the single richest feeder of Highland-stage assets.

balderton.com.name: Balderton Capital
balderton.com.note: Series A plus dedicated growth fund; the most consistent UK co-investor and upstream source.

atomico.com.name: Atomico
atomico.com.note: A through growth, pan-European reach; direct competitor on growth rounds and a strong signal when they lead early.

dawncapital.com.name: Dawn Capital
dawncapital.com.note: Europe's largest B2B software specialist; their A/B portfolio is a ready-made Highland pipeline.

pluralplatform.com.name: Plural
pluralplatform.com.note: Operator-led (Hinrikus, Hogarth); the strongest new early-stage franchise in Europe - watch everything they seed.

localglobe.vc.name: LocalGlobe / Phoenix Court
localglobe.vc.note: London's premier seed platform (plus Latitude growth); dominant top-of-funnel for UK tech.

seedcamp.com.name: Seedcamp
seedcamp.com.note: Pre-seed institution (Wise, Revolut, UiPath); highest-coverage early index of UK founders.

sequoiacap.com.name: Sequoia Capital
sequoiacap.com.note: US fund, London office since 2021; leads the most contested seed-to-growth deals in the UK.

octopusventures.com.name: Octopus Ventures
octopusventures.com.note: One of Europe's largest VCs by volume; ubiquitous across UK health, fintech and deeptech pipeline.

notioncapital.com.name: Notion Capital
notioncapital.com.note: SaaS/cloud specialist with opportunity fund; cleanest B2B feeder into Highland's sweet spot.

generalcatalyst.com.name: General Catalyst
generalcatalyst.com.note: US fund, London office (absorbed La Famiglia); aggressive European early and growth cheques.

moltenventures.com.name: Molten Ventures
moltenventures.com.note: Listed multi-stage VC; broad UK portfolio and secondaries appetite make them a frequent counterpart.

83north.com.name: 83North
83north.com.note: London/Tel Aviv, A through growth; strong enterprise and fintech book on the UK-Israel axis.

lsvp.com.name: Lightspeed Venture Partners
lsvp.com.note: US fund, London office; leads UK AI and enterprise rounds from seed to pre-IPO.

onepeak.tech.name: One Peak
onepeak.tech.note: B2B software growth equity (€10-100m); one of the most direct London competitors for Highland's core deal.

hoxtonventures.com.name: Hoxton Ventures
hoxtonventures.com.note: Contrarian seed (Darktrace, Deliveroo); best outlier-hit-rate per pound at UK seed.

firstminute.capital.name: firstminute capital
firstminute.capital.note: Hoberman's seed fund; unrivalled founder/LP network and broad UK seed coverage.

felixcap.com.name: Felix Capital
felixcap.com.note: Consumer and digital-lifestyle specialist; the reference feeder for Highland consumer-internet deals.

eightroads.com.name: Eight Roads
eightroads.com.note: Fidelity's proprietary-capital arm, London-led in Europe; B/C cheques directly adjacent to Highland's range.

thetwentyminutevc.com.name: 20VC
thetwentyminutevc.com.note: Stebbings's 20VC/20Growth; founder access and signal density beyond its AUM.

mmc.vc.name: MMC Ventures
mmc.vc.note: Research-led Series A in AI/data; consistently early into UK enterprise winners.

hummingbird.vc.name: Hummingbird Ventures
hummingbird.vc.note: High-conviction early fund; exceptional outlier record (Deliveroo, Peak, Kraken).

blossomcap.com.name: Blossom Capital
blossomcap.com.note: Concentrated Series A (Checkout.com, Duffel); few deals, high quality bar.

airstreet.com.name: Air Street Capital
airstreet.com.note: Benaich's AI-first seed fund; the best-networked AI seed investor in Europe and an early-warning system for the category.

iqcapital.vc.name: IQ Capital
iqcapital.vc.note: Deeptech seed-to-growth; the strongest institutional feeder of UK deeptech into growth rounds.

crane.vc.name: Crane Venture Partners
crane.vc.note: Enterprise/AI seed specialist; disciplined B2B theses that mature into Highland-stage assets.

kindredcapital.vc.name: Kindred Capital
kindredcapital.vc.note: Quality generalist seed (Paddle, Five); reliable A-round feeder.

connectventures.co.name: Connect Ventures
connectventures.co.note: Product-led seed (Typeform, TrueLayer); small portfolio, high craft.

moonfire.com.name: Moonfire Ventures
moonfire.com.note: Ljungman's AI-native seed fund; data-driven sourcing, growing UK footprint.

quantumlightcapital.com.name: QuantumLight
quantumlightcapital.com.note: Storonsky's quant fund; fast, data-led A/B cheques - increasingly present in competitive UK processes.

rtp.vc.name: RTP Global
rtp.vc.note: Global early-stage fund HQ'd in London (Datadog, DeliveryHero); deep pockets at seed/A.

amadeuscapital.com.name: Amadeus Capital Partners
amadeuscapital.com.note: Deeptech veteran (Cambridge roots); steady source of technical companies reaching growth stage.

cic.vc.name: Cambridge Innovation Capital
cic.vc.note: The institutional anchor of Cambridge deeptech/life sciences; gateway to the cluster.

dst-global.com.name: DST Global
dst-global.com.note: Milner's growth firm; when DST moves on a UK company it defines the round. Signal more than partner.

frontline.vc.name: Frontline Ventures
frontline.vc.note: Dublin/London B2B seed plus Frontline Growth; strong US-Europe bridge thesis.

expedition.capital.name: Expedition Growth Capital
expedition.capital.note: Bootstrapped-software growth equity; hunts the same capital-efficient assets as Highland below €30m.

albion.vc.name: AlbionVC
albion.vc.note: Series A B2B software and health; manages UCL Technology Fund - university-pipeline access.

kennet.com.name: Kennet Partners
kennet.com.note: Bootstrapped-SaaS growth equity; direct competitor on capital-efficient software deals.

chalfenventures.com.name: Chalfen Ventures
chalfenventures.com.note: Solo GP with top-decile judgment; co-invests alongside tier-1 funds up the stack.

hedosophia.com.name: Hedosophia
hedosophia.com.note: Osborne's secretive growth firm; large fintech/marketplace positions, no publicity. Worth tracking via rounds, not PR.

joinef.com.name: Entrepreneur First
joinef.com.note: Talent investor; the single densest source of ambitious technical founders in the UK.

parequity.com.name: Par Equity
parequity.com.note: Edinburgh's leading early-stage investor; the gateway to Scottish dealflow.

oxfordscienceenterprises.com.name: Oxford Science Enterprises
oxfordscienceenterprises.com.note: The preferred investor for Oxford spinouts (£850m+ raised); the institutional door to the Oxford cluster.

nautacapital.com.name: Nauta
nautacapital.com.note: B2B software seed/A (London/Barcelona); steady enterprise feeder.

vitruvianpartners.com.name: Vitruvian Partners
vitruvianpartners.com.note: Tech growth buyout above Highland's range; competitor at the top end and a buyer of growth assets.

backed.vc.name: Backed VC
backed.vc.note: Human-centric seed brand with loyal technical founder following.

13bookscapital.com.name: 13books Capital
13bookscapital.com.note: Fintech specialist seed/A; the UK fintech pipeline in miniature.

parkwalk.vc.name: Parkwalk Advisors
parkwalk.vc.note: University-spinout EIS leader (IP Group-owned); volume access to Oxbridge deeptech.

ipgroupplc.com.name: IP Group
ipgroupplc.com.note: Listed deeptech/life-sciences investor; patient balance-sheet capital behind UK science.

ahreninnovationcapital.com.name: Ahren Innovation Capital
ahreninnovationcapital.com.note: Deep-science fund (Cambridge DNA); large cheques into frontier tech.

dig.ventures.name: DIG Ventures
dig.ventures.note: Ross Mason's (MuleSoft) SaaS/infra seed; operator-grade B2B judgment.

hgcapital.com.name: Hg
hgcapital.com.note: Europe's software buyout machine; the most likely buyer of Highland's B2B portfolio - relationship matters.

projecteurope.co.name: Project Europe
projecteurope.co.note: New pre-seed fund with 128 top founders as LPs; early index of the next European cohort.

greyhoundcapital.com.name: Greyhound Capital
greyhoundcapital.com.note: Quiet growth investor (fintech/software); occasional direct competitor.

northern-gritstone.com.name: Northern Gritstone
northern-gritstone.com.note: University-spinout capital for Leeds/Manchester/Sheffield; the institutional seed of the North.

adaventures.com.name: Ada Ventures
adaventures.com.note: Inclusive-thesis seed; differentiated sourcing outside the usual networks.

smedvig.vc.name: Smedvig Ventures
smedvig.vc.note: Family-backed evergreen Series A; patient, concentrated B2B.

praeturaventures.com.name: Praetura Ventures
praeturaventures.com.note: Manchester's leading early-stage manager; core north-west coverage.

lightrock.com.name: Lightrock
lightrock.com.note: LGT-backed impact growth; large cheques, mission filter limits overlap.

pentech.vc.name: Pentech
pentech.vc.note: B2B software seed with Scottish roots (FanDuel heritage).

anthemis.com.name: Anthemis
anthemis.com.note: Fintech pioneer; quieter post-2022 but networks still deep.

thecreatorfund.com.name: Creator Fund
thecreatorfund.com.note: PhD/student founder seed across UK universities; cheap early look at academic talent.

mercia.co.uk.name: Mercia
mercia.co.uk.note: Regional VCT/EIS volume manager; wide Midlands/North coverage, small cheques.

techstart.vc.name: Techstart Ventures
techstart.vc.note: Pre-seed across Scotland and Northern Ireland; earliest regional signal.

scottish-enterprise.com.name: Scottish Enterprise
scottish-enterprise.com.note: Scotland's development agency; highest-volume co-investor in Scottish rounds - coverage, not competition.

insightpartners.com.name: Insight Partners
insightpartners.com.note: Software growth at industrial scale from NY with a London office; prices and wins the European rounds Highland sees in every process.

tcv.com.name: TCV
tcv.com.note: US fund, London office since 2012 (Doran); Revolut, Mollie, Trade Republic - the US growth franchise most embedded in European software and fintech.

battery.com.name: Battery Ventures
battery.com.note: US fund, London office since 2016 (Ewen/Elhafed); later-stage European software and industrial tech - frequent competitor on capital-efficient growth deals.

bvp.com.name: Bessemer Venture Partners
bvp.com.note: US fund, London office since 2021; Ferrara/Nidmarti/Chung cover expansion and growth European SaaS - direct Highland-stage overlap.

summitpartners.com.name: Summit Partners
summitpartners.com.note: Boston growth equity with a dedicated EUR1.4bn Europe fund run from London; hunts the same capital-efficient software Highland does.

ivp.com.name: IVP
ivp.com.note: Late-stage venture; first office outside the Bay Area opened in London 2023 (Liaw) - cheques above Highland's entry but a strong downstream signal.

leftlanecapital.com.name: Left Lane Capital
leftlanecapital.com.note: Brooklyn growth firm with a real London seat (Dillon); internet and consumer subscription growth - roughly a quarter of deals European.

sapphireventures.com.name: Sapphire Ventures
sapphireventures.com.note: Enterprise software growth with an SAP-anchored LP base; London office since 2020 (Diestel) - co-invests at Highland's stage.
